decisions.reason: As a newly launched service already prominent on the home page, it likely represents a strategic cloud offering the firm will continue to build rather than exit after only one year.
A standalone page suggests meaningful positioning in the portfolio, and document capture/recognition fits well with business information and workflow services in the German B2B market.
Although less prominently marketed, email-fax conversion complements established enterprise communications needs and is likely to retain enough niche demand to stay on the market.
As an optimization feature rather than a large standalone product, it is relatively cheap to maintain and supports the reliability expectations of existing fax-related customers.
Email threat protection is strategically relevant for business customers, so even with modest initial visibility the firm is more likely to refine it than withdraw it quickly.
Multi-engine virus scanning is useful but may face cost and overlap pressures; still, security capabilities are important enough that the firm would usually keep it in the short term.
